feeds.description: Political Cartoons by A.F. Branco. Branco has become one of the most sought after political cartoonist in journalism. His work has been featured on numerous conservative political websites and Fox News.

feeds.title: Jen Sorensen
feeds.description: Jen Sorensen Cartoonist, Writer, Cultural Panopticon. Her comics and illustrations have appeared in numerous publications including The Progressive, The Nation, Daily Kos, NPR and more.

feeds.title: Political Toons
feeds.description: There are times when I am sitting in the kitchen table, relaxing, having a cigar with a shot of good whiskey. Reading the paper or watching the cable news. Then I can't help it, I have the need to make a RAW drawing on how I feel about the political world. Before, after the drawing was done, it will end in the trash, now I have a blog, maybe someone out there may like to see what I do. Either way, I just do it for me.

feeds.title: The Daily Cartoonist
feeds.description: The Daily Cartoonist is the leading daily news and opinion blog for professional cartoonists, covering comic strips, editorial cartooning, webcomics, animation, and cartooning history since 2005.

feeds.title: Dave Granlund
feeds.description: This curated page showcases award-winning political cartoons by Dave Granlund, offering timely visual commentary on topics like tornadoes, India-Pakistan tensions, Ukraine-Russia diplomacy, and U.S. leadership dynamics—showcasing a powerful blend of wit and insight across global issues.

feeds.title: Political Graffiti
feeds.description: I was born and raised in the Detroit area. I began my political cartooning career in college for the Eastern Echo. My first professional gig was at the Macomb Daily and then the Grosse Pointe News. My biggest influence was Draper Hill who was the Detroit News cartoonist from the 1970s thru the 90s.

feeds.title: Michael de Adder
feeds.description: Michael de Adder is an internationally renowned, award-winning cartoonist, living in Halifax, Nova Scotia. His blog features his latest cartoons, as well as news about his work, upcoming events, and links to his other online platforms.

feeds.title: Cartoon Movement Blog
feeds.description: The Cartoon Movement was set up and is run by Dutch editorial cartoonist Tjeerd Royaards. The blog of Cartoon Movement, the Internet's #1 publishing platform for high quality political cartoons and comics journalism, relatively new form of journalism that uses a graphic story. The mission of the Cartoon Movement is to bring different perspectives on international news events to a global audience.
